# drafting

Full CAD drafting-view authoring: detail views, linework, curves, hatched/halftone/screened/masking regions, 2D components, repeating details, batt insulation, masked notes with filled NCS leaders, margin-aligned callout stacks, dimensions, modify operations, auto-crop, and layout QA.

Every example below is a complete script that passes the kit's checks; the kit's tests run each one.

- [`drafting.view`](#draftingview): Creates a 2D CAD drafting detail view (default scale 16 = 3/4" = 1'-0").
- [`drafting.fitCrop`](#draftingfitcrop): Fits a drafting view's crop box tightly around every drawn item, note, leader, and dimension with a clean paper margin (default 0.35 in).
- [`drafting.line`](#draftingline): Draws a 2D detail line between two typed points with optional CAD line style, weight, pattern, category, and detail group.
- [`drafting.rect`](#draftingrect): Draws a rectangle as four joined detail lines; accepts `{ at, width, height }` or `{ corner, opposite }`.
- [`drafting.chain`](#draftingchain): Draws a joined chain of detail lines through `points` (pass `closed: true` to close the loop).
- [`drafting.polygon`](#draftingpolygon): Draws a regular inscribed or circumscribed N-sided polygon as joined detail lines.
- [`drafting.arc`](#draftingarc): Draws a center-start-end circular detail arc.
- [`drafting.arcRadius`](#draftingarcradius): Draws a start-end-radius circular detail arc bulging toward `toward`.
- [`drafting.arcTangent`](#draftingarctangent): Draws a circular arc tangent to `from -> start` ending at `end`.
- [`drafting.circle`](#draftingcircle): Draws a 2D detail circle from `center` and `radius`.
- [`drafting.spline`](#draftingspline): Draws a smooth Catmull-Rom detail spline through three or more points.
- [`drafting.region`](#draftingregion): Draws a CAD hatched/filled or opaque white masking region (`points` or `rect` shorthand), supporting all CAD hatch patterns and `tone: "ink" | "halftone" | "screened"`.
- [`drafting.component`](#draftingcomponent): Places a 2D detail component from the kernel or active discipline packs (`mechanical.hooded_louver`, `mechanical.concentric_diffuser`, `mechanical.exhaust_fan_ceiling`, `mechanical.roof_curb_rail`, `mechanical.volume_damper`, `break_line`, `flow_arrow`, …).
- [`drafting.repeat`](#draftingrepeat): Repeats a 2D detail component evenly along `from -> to` (studs, decking, hangers, masonry courses).
- [`drafting.batt`](#draftingbatt): Draws a standard CAD batt insulation zig-zag strip of `thickness` between `from` and `to`.
- [`drafting.breakLine`](#draftingbreakline): Places an architectural/mechanical zig-zag break line along `from -> to`, with an optional masking strip on the cut-off side.
- [`drafting.note`](#draftingnote): Places a CAD rich-text note (`create_text_note`) on a view or sheet with word wrap, opaque paper-white background mask (on by default when supported), and auto-elbowed horizontal-shoulder leaders with filled NCS arrowheads.
- [`drafting.calloutStack`](#draftingcalloutstack): Places a vertically aligned left or right margin column of callout notes auto-spaced by exact wrapped line height (zero text overlaps) with horizontal-shoulder leaders to each target.
- [`drafting.detailTitle`](#draftingdetailtitle): Draws an NCS-standard detail subtitle heading (bold title + heavy underline rule + optional scale/subtitle) inside a drafting view.
- [`drafting.dimension`](#draftingdimension): Draws a CAD detail dimension (two-point `from`/`to` or continuous chain `points`) with typed paper offset, prefix, suffix, text override, and style.
- [`drafting.modify`](#draftingmodify): Runs any CAD Modify operation (move, copy, rotate, scale, mirror, arrays, align, offset, trim/extend, split, fillet, chamfer, pin, match_type, delete) on drafted items.
- [`drafting.group`](#draftinggroup): Assigns drafted items to a named detail group so they select, move, and copy together.
- [`drafting.catalog`](#draftingcatalog): Lists all available 2D detail components (kernel + active discipline packs), hatch patterns, region tones, line styles, line patterns, line weights, and leader arrows.
- [`drafting.check`](#draftingcheck): Audits a drafting view for CAD legibility & print quality: text-vs-text overlaps, unmasked text crossing linework, items clipped outside crop, and orphaned dimensions.

## drafting.view

Creates a 2D CAD drafting detail view (default scale 16 = 3/4" = 1'-0"). Returns the view's id.

```ts
view(ctx: ScriptContext, spec: DetailViewSpec): string
```

Topics: drafting, detail view, create detail, cad view, scale

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const detail = drafting.view(ctx, { name: "Roof Curb Detail", scale: 16, discipline: "mechanical" });
    drafting.rect(ctx, { view: detail, at: { x: units.in(0), y: units.in(0) }, width: units.in(48), height: units.in(24), lineStyle: "wide" });
  },
});
```

</details>

## drafting.fitCrop

Fits a drafting view's crop box tightly around every drawn item, note, leader, and dimension with a clean paper margin (default 0.35 in).

```ts
fitCrop(ctx: ScriptContext, view: string, opts?: { margin?: Measure; modelMargin?: Measure }): { readonly min: { readonly x: number; readonly y: number }; readonly max: { readonly x: number; readonly y: number }; readonly itemCount: number }
```

Topics: fit crop, crop box, detail bounds, drafting crop

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const detail = drafting.view(ctx, { name: "Curb Detail", scale: 16 });
    drafting.rect(ctx, { view: detail, at: { x: units.in(0), y: units.in(0) }, width: units.in(48), height: units.in(24), lineStyle: "wide" });
    drafting.fitCrop(ctx, detail, { margin: units.in(0.4) });
  },
});
```

</details>

## drafting.note

Places a CAD rich-text note (`create_text_note`) on a view or sheet with word wrap, opaque paper-white background mask (on by default when supported), and auto-elbowed horizontal-shoulder leaders with filled NCS arrowheads.

```ts
note(ctx: ScriptContext, spec: DraftNoteSpec): string
```

Topics: note, sheet note, general notes, callout, leader, text note, mask, arrow, annotation

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const detail = drafting.view(ctx, { name: "Note Example", scale: 16 });
    drafting.rect(ctx, { view: detail, at: { x: units.in(0), y: units.in(0) }, width: units.in(36), height: units.in(20), lineStyle: "wide" });
    drafting.note(ctx, { view: detail, at: { x: units.in(48), y: units.in(18) }, text: "14\" INSULATED ROOF CURB\nW/ CANT STRIP & FLASHING", leaders: [{ to: { x: units.in(36), y: units.in(14) } }] });
  },
});
```

</details>

## drafting.calloutStack

Places a vertically aligned left or right margin column of callout notes auto-spaced by exact wrapped line height (zero text overlaps) with horizontal-shoulder leaders to each target.

```ts
calloutStack(ctx: ScriptContext, spec: DraftCalloutStackSpec): string[]
```

Topics: callout stack, aligned callouts, leader column, detail notes, no overlap, clean detail

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";

  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const detail = drafting.view(ctx, { name: "RTU Detail", scale: 16 });
    drafting.rect(ctx, { view: detail, at: { x: units.in(0), y: units.in(0) }, width: units.in(48), height: units.in(30), lineStyle: "wide" });
```

## drafting.modify

Runs any CAD Modify operation (move, copy, rotate, scale, mirror, arrays, align, offset, trim/extend, split, fillet, chamfer, pin, match_type, delete) on drafted items.

```ts
modify(ctx: ScriptContext, spec: { view: string; items: readonly string[]; op: DraftModifyOp }): void
```

Topics: modify, trim, extend, offset, fillet, chamfer, mirror, array, split, align

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const detail = drafting.view(ctx, { name: "Chamfered Curb", scale: 16 });
    const l1 = drafting.line(ctx, { view: detail, from: { x: units.in(0), y: units.in(0) }, to: { x: units.in(24), y: units.in(0) } });
    const l2 = drafting.line(ctx, { view: detail, from: { x: units.in(24), y: units.in(0) }, to: { x: units.in(24), y: units.in(24) } });
    drafting.modify(ctx, { view: detail, items: [l1, l2], op: { op: "fillet", radius: units.in(4) } });
  },
});
```

</details>

Assigns drafted items to a named detail group so they select, move, and copy together.

```ts
group(ctx: ScriptContext, spec: { view: string; items: readonly string[]; group: string }): void
```

Topics: detail group, group, group items

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const detail = drafting.view(ctx, { name: "Grouped Detail", scale: 16 });
    const box = drafting.rect(ctx, { view: detail, at: { x: units.in(0), y: units.in(0) }, width: units.in(12), height: units.in(12) });
    drafting.group(ctx, { view: detail, items: box, group: "curb-assembly" });
  },
});
```

</details>

## drafting.catalog

Lists all available 2D detail components (kernel + active discipline packs), hatch patterns, region tones, line styles, line patterns, line weights, and leader arrows.

```ts
catalog(ctx: ScriptContext): { readonly components: readonly { readonly id: string; readonly name: string; readonly category: string; readonly widthIn: number; readonly heightIn: number; readonly linear: boolean }[]; readonly hatchPatterns: readonly HatchPattern[]; readonly regionTones: readonly RegionTone[]; readonly lineStyles: readonly { readonly id: DetailLineStyleId; readonly name: string }[]; readonly linePatterns: readonly LinePattern2D[]; readonly lineWeights: readonly LineWeight2D[]; readonly leaderArrows: readonly NoteLeaderArrow[] }
```

Topics: drafting catalog, detail components, hatch patterns, line styles, symbols, mechanical symbols

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const cat = drafting.catalog(ctx);
    ctx.report("Drafting catalog", { components: cat.components.length, hatches: cat.hatchPatterns.length });
  },
});
```

</details>

## drafting.check

Audits a drafting view for CAD legibility & print quality: text-vs-text overlaps, unmasked text crossing linework, items clipped outside crop, and orphaned dimensions.

```ts
check(ctx: ScriptContext, view: string): DetailAudit
```

Topics: detail audit, check detail, overlap, text collision, legibility, qa, crop check

<details><summary>Example script</summary>

```ts
import { defineScript, units, routes, parts, building, equipment, documents, markups, drafting, checks, electrical } from "@permitzip/bim-script";
export default defineScript({
  kind: "layout",
  reads: { levels: true },
  parameters: {},
  run(ctx) {
    const detail = drafting.view(ctx, { name: "QA Detail", scale: 16 });
    drafting.rect(ctx, { view: detail, at: { x: units.in(0), y: units.in(0) }, width: units.in(36), height: units.in(18), lineStyle: "wide" });
    drafting.calloutStack(ctx, { view: detail, side: "right", x: units.in(44), topY: units.in(16), notes: [{ text: "ROOF CURB", to: { x: units.in(36), y: units.in(10) } }] });
    drafting.fitCrop(ctx, detail);
    const qa = drafting.check(ctx, detail);
    ctx.report("Detail QA", qa);
  },
});
```

</details>
